young_child.description: Parental consent required for children under 13

teen.description: Parent should be notified; child can provide assent

legal_obligations: Consent for collection and use of personal data
Accuracy and Protection of personal data
Protection of personal data against loss and unauthorized access
Retention of personal data - do not retain longer than necessary
Openness - make available details of personal data held
Accuracy - take reasonable steps to ensure accuracy
Access - reasonable access to personal data
Correction - reasonable efforts to correct inaccurate data

consent_documentation.description: Must obtain and document consent for data collection

privacy_notification.description: Must notify individuals about collection and use of personal data

data_security.description: Must protect personal data against loss and unauthorized access

access_mechanism.description: Must provide reasonable access to personal data held

correction_mechanism.description: Must provide mechanism to correct inaccurate data

warnings: PDPA applies to organizations in Singapore processing personal data
Parental consent required for children under 13
Must notify individuals before collecting personal data
Must protect data against loss and unauthorized access
Must not retain data longer than necessary
Penalties can include fines up to SGD 1 million and/or imprisonment
requirements: Obtain explicit parental consent for children under 13
Notify individuals of data collection and purposes
Implement security measures to protect personal data
Do not retain personal data longer than necessary
Provide access to personal data held
Allow correction of inaccurate personal data
